description_for_human: Model-visible live data for the 5 Bell parking garage.
description_for_model: Authenticated, read-only live garage data. Always call the matching function together with its ParkAssist SPFx UX tool so the user receives both a same-turn factual answer and an interactive dashboard.

functions.name: garage-overview-data
functions.description: Return live 5 Bell occupancy, availability, out-of-service, and camera-health numbers as text and structured data.

functions.name: find-available-spaces-data
functions.description: Return available-space totals and bays, optionally filtered by floor or designation.

functions.name: search-license-plate-data
functions.description: Return occupied bay matches for at least three license-plate characters.

functions.name: get-stale-camera-feeds-data
functions.description: Return stale or missing camera-feed totals and affected bays for the requested scope.
